EXHIBIT A — D

Case Files — Selected Work

Four recurring engagement types, each broken down from raw requirement to structured, implementation-ready output.

EXHIBIT A

AI Product & MCA Output Audit

Reviewed AI/product outputs, looked for gaps and translated findings into a structured improvement report.

Focus: output quality · usability · missing requirements · improvement roadmap

EXHIBIT B

Tender & Technical Proposal Analysis

Compared tender/proposal documents, identified feature coverage and under-defined requirements, and flagged practical implementation considerations.

Focus: requirement mapping · feature comparison · risk/gap identification · proposal readiness

EXHIBIT C

Business Process & Sales Improvement

Identified operational problems, software/process limitations and practical actions to improve sales execution and company efficiency.

Focus: workflow · calling/process system · reporting · management visibility

EXHIBIT D

AI / Software Feature Planning

Converted business needs into structured feature ideas and implementation points for software and developer teams.

Focus: product thinking · requirements · implementation coordination · prioritization

SEQUENCE BREAKDOWN

The Method — Five-Act Process

Every engagement runs through the same five acts, in the same order, every time.

I

Understand

Clearly define the requirement or business problem.

II

Analyze

Identify gaps in the current system, workflow, documents or output.

III

Design

Structure a practical solution, features, priorities and action points.

IV

Execute

Support team/developer coordination and implementation follow-up.

V

Report

Convert results, risks, pending work and next steps into clear documentation.

FEATURE PRESENTATION

KVL Business Solutions — Founder's Cut

Since 2015, KVL Business Solutions has built custom software, ERP, CRM and AI automation for hospitals, schools, factories, real estate and government offices out of Patna, Bihar — one accountable team covering enterprise software, GPS/industrial systems, civil-mechanical engineering and digital marketing, so clients don't chase multiple vendors. Under my leadership since 2023, it runs two roles at once: an agency building for clients, and a product company operating its own live SaaS line as proof, not promises.
